evidence.finding: The complete initializer establishes the 0x84-byte allocator, creates an object and user data, stores the byte-converted argument, initializes RGB scale to 1, loads lbBgFlashColAnimData from LbBf.dat, initializes the overlay with argument 6, resets animation state, and registers fn_80021B04.

The complete update callback advances the animation, scales RGB by the global floating-point scale, scales alpha by the stored byte divided by 255, and submits the resulting color. When animation color becomes disabled, it clears overlay alpha.

InitState copies the submitted color into overlay state; the parameterized initializer uses its argument for graphics-link priorities. The separate no-argument initializer constructs the overlay at priority 10 without loading the color-animation table or creating the animation-player callback.

Verified the allocation-failure cleanup against the complete removal implementation: HSD_GObjPLink_80390228 removes object resources, unlinks the object, and frees it, with deferred removal handling for the currently executing object.
